intro: Our Terrene dining table is designed to fit seamlessly into your home. Its timeless marble top, warm wood base & versatile design make it a dining centrepiece you’ll love for years to come.

features.title: Marble-look top that stays timeless
features.text: The synthetic marble top adds lasting elegance & resists stains & moisture, making it easy to clean after every meal.

features.title: Strong ash wood base for stability
features.text: Solid ash wood legs add natural warmth while giving the table sturdy, dependable support for years of shared meals & gatherings.

features.title: Durable & easy for everyday life
features.text: Built for beauty & practicality, the marble-look top resists spills & scratches, so your table stays beautiful with minimal effort.

features.title: Ergonomic design for ultimate comfort
features.text: Enjoy lasting comfort—the curved backrest with vertical cushioning supports your posture through every meal and gathering.

features.title: A design that blends effortlessly
features.text: With its soft tones & natural finishes, Terrene pairs easily with modern, minimal or even eclectic dining spaces.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Terrene 6-Seater Synthetic Marble Rectangular Dining Set
